title: Night phonk kit
description: Atoms (chords, lines, rhythms, section gates), racks (instrument rigs as hook defs) and the night phonk track presets (v1, v2). v2 only adds ingredients (atoms-v2, racks-v2); the track programs only compose them. 1.3 adds hip-hop, trap and hyphy components and forms (atoms-hiphop, racks-hiphop), dovetail atoms (atoms-dovetail) and five feel templates (feel-*), generated by tools/concepts/build.mjs.

ingredients.title: Phonk atoms
ingredients.description: 22 typed atoms under ph.: chords, 808 line and glide, lead, counter, cowbell, drum rhythms, section gates

ingredients.title: Phonk racks
ingredients.description: Instrument rigs as chain-only hook defs: kick808, snareNoise, hat, cowbell, sub808, hazePad, deepLead, wideLead, echoPluck, formant, chop, riser, reverseHit, impact, tape; moves murk, thin, grit, pump

ingredients.title: Phonk atoms v2
ingredients.description: under ph2.: confrontation rhythms (toms, rim, stab, stut, heart), 808 slides and the v2 section gates

ingredients.title: Phonk racks v2
ingredients.description: pumpHard (kick-synced duckorbit pump), tom, rimshot, slam, open, swellPad

ingredients.title: Phonk presets
ingredients.description: Track demo: night phonk (the paste-ready standalone program)

ingredients.title: Hip-hop and dovetail racks
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs: bbKick, knock808, clap, snap, openHat, bbBass, rhodes, trapBell, airPad, hyphyLead, chopStab, voxTag, vinyl, downlifter, fadeOut, fadeIn, throw, tailHold, duckUnder

ingredients.title: Hip-hop atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/phonk hip-hop atoms (hh.): boom-bap, trap and hyphy drum patterns, hats and rolls, 808 and bass lines, chords, chops, tags; song-form gates (intro, verse, hook, bridge, outro, drop-in, drop bar, last-beat drop, beat switch, bounce, stomp).

ingredients.title: Dovetail atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/phonk dovetail atoms (dt.): gate atoms with a point param for pickups, rises, hits and tails; masks for call-and-response handoffs; equal-power fade tables; a turnaround.

ingredients.title: Feel: Boom-bap pocket
ingredients.description: Feel template "Boom-bap pocket" (86-94 bpm): swing 57 on 16ths, snare and keys a little behind, vinyl bed. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Lazy drag
ingredients.description: Feel template "Lazy drag" (78-86 bpm): everything behind the beat (push 8), kick a little ahead of the rest, snare dragged furthest, slow drift. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Rolling trap
ingredients.description: Feel template "Rolling trap" (130-150 bpm (half-time)): straight grid, velocity life on the hats and rolls, 808 and pad tight. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Bouncy hyphy
ingredients.description: Feel template "Bouncy hyphy" (98-106 bpm): light swing, claps rushing a hair, snaps on the ands, bounce kick and a square lead. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Cloud / wave
ingredients.description: Feel template "Cloud / wave" (60-75 bpm): loose and floating: swing 56, everything a little late, slow drift, big pad. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Groove presets
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs, the standard-library presets as pack content: groove-straight, groove-pocket, groove-lazy, groove-bounce, groove-rolling, groove-cloud, groove-swing, groove-push, groove-human
